title: Short Late-Night Leg Workout

context.notes: Short late-night leg session followed by 15 minutes in a dry sauna. No numeric 0–6 readiness or pain ratings were supplied.

exercises.name: Smith-Machine Squat
exercises.notes: The 25 lb Smith bar was the warm-up. Working sets totaled 24 repetitions and 3,040 lb of volume. The two 135 lb sets establish the heaviest recorded Smith-squat load. RIR and back-pain response were not supplied.

exercises.name: Smith-Machine Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: The 25 lb Smith bar was the warm-up. The three working sets establish a 75 lb × 10, 10, 10 Smith-RDL baseline. Back-pain response and RIR were not supplied, so this load is not labeled pain-free or ready to increase.

notes: Workout started at 11:15 PM local time on September 3 and lasted 25 minutes. It contained eight completed sets, 74 completed repetitions, and 5,790 lb of volume including two 25 lb warm-up sets. Working sets totaled 54 repetitions and 5,290 lb. A 15-minute dry sauna followed the workout and is recorded separately from lifting duration and volume. No RIR, back-pain, energy, sleep, soreness, or illness scores were supplied.
